items.title: Pulai MP Wants Clarity On Nicotine Vape Control, Taxation Status
items.summary: Pulai MP Suhaizan Kaiat wants Putrajaya to explain nicotine vape's taxation status and how it will be regulated, expressing support for nicotine remaining on the Poisons List. Nicotine shouldn't be seen solely as a trade or tax issue, but public health. The post Pulai MP Wants Clarity On Nicotine Vape Control, Taxation Status appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Malaysian Medical Negligence Damages Still Too Low: Lawyer
items.summary: Despite court awards exceeding RM8 million or RM9 million, lawyer Manmohan Singh Dhillon says Malaysia’s medical negligence damages remain too low for catastrophic injuries, citing restrictions on lost earnings and gaps in funding lifelong care. items.title: Ronald McCoy Was A Remarkable Doctor, Global Peace Advocate — MMA
items.summary: Dr Ronald McCoy helped initiate the International Campaign to Abolish Nuclear Weapons, which was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 2017. items.title: Vape Businesses, Consumers Demand Clarity On Legality Of Nicotine Vape
items.summary: The Malaysian Vape Chamber of Commerce and Malaysian Vapers Alliance want clarity from the government on the legal status of nicotine vape, saying they want regulation under Act 852, but omit mention of the Poisons Act that lists nicotine as a poison. The post Vape Businesses, Consumers Demand Clarity On Legality Of Nicotine Vape appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Budget 2027: Fund Multi-Year Recruitment, Retention Of Malaysian And Foreign Health Workers, Says Galen Centre
items.summary: Budget 2027 must fund a multi-year recruitment and retention programme for health workers in the public sector like doctors and nurses, both Malaysian and foreign, says the Galen Centre. Local supply can't meet the gap even if local talent is preferred. items.title: Why Malaysia’s Health Care Financing Model Is Mathematically Unsustainable
items.summary: Malaysia’s health financing model is fundamentally unsustainable because most Malaysians don't pay income tax. This is also the reason why a mandatory NHI scheme isn't feasible. MediAsas is also just a mirage because it's just private health insurance. The post Why Malaysia’s Health Care Financing Model Is Mathematically Unsustainable appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Declare Nicotine Vape Illegal As Poison, Stop Collecting Tax: MPs
items.summary: Petaling Jaya and Kuala Langat MPs tell the government to ban nicotine vape as a scheduled poison under the Poisons Act and to stop collecting excise duties on it, saying MOF must also refund businesses over RM354m in excise duties collected since 2023. The post Declare Nicotine Vape Illegal As Poison, Stop Collecting Tax: MPs appeared first on CodeBlue .
